firing.source: export function f(): void { throw new Error(); }

findings.message: This throws a bare `Error`, which names no declared failure. Raise it through the tier that declares it, `AccountModule.error(identifier, data, cause)`, `ApiWorker.error(...)` or `Base.error(...)`. A bare throw carries no identifier, so the board groups it by its message and one interpolated value mints one identity per value, and it normalizes to 500, so a refusal reads as our fault.
